text: What is the difference between launch and async in Kotlin coroutines?
modelAnswer: launch starts a fire-and-forget coroutine returning a Job without a result. async returns a Deferred<T> whose result can be retrieved by calling await().

text: Explain CoroutineScope and why it matters for avoiding memory leaks.
modelAnswer: CoroutineScope controls coroutine lifetimes. Cancelling a scope cancels all child coroutines running inside it. Structured scopes like viewModelScope automatically cancel jobs when ViewModels are cleared.

text: What is a Flow in Kotlin and how is it different from a suspend function?
modelAnswer: A suspend function returns a single value asynchronously, while a Flow emits multiple sequential values asynchronously over time.
